title: Temple of Heaven's ¥15 Ticket Misses All 3 Monuments | China Travel Expert
description:
At the Temple of Heaven in Beijing, the cheap ¥15 gate ticket (peak season, Apr 1–Oct 31) only gets you into the park. Buy that and you'll walk right past the three monuments people actually come for.

To enter the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the Echo Wall around the Imperial Vault of Heaven, and the Circular Mound Altar, you need the through-ticket (联票) — about ¥34 in peak season, ¥28 off-season. It's one of the best-value heritage tickets in Beijing once you get the right one.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book the combined through-ticket (联票), not the park-only ticket — it's the one that opens all three monuments, and you reserve it digitally before you go.

天坛公园门票只进园；要看祈年殿、回音壁、圜丘坛这三大景点，得买约¥34的联票——你会买便宜的门票，还是直接上联票？
